== Summary ==
Before/after image for [[Twin Suns Of Tatooine / Well Trained In The Jedi Arts (Errata 2)]]: the PC card image of [[Twin Suns Of Tatooine / Well Trained In The Jedi Arts (Errata)]] (12 December 2022, [[:File:VP-D-twinsunsoftatooine.gif|VP-D-twinsunsoftatooine.gif]], scaled to the slip height) beside the slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-P.pdf Virtual Set P release sheet (updated December 2022)] (page 1). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026).
